clue.text: Written paper having minutes on old plot

parts.note: to plot data is to graph it; a graph is a plot

explanation.surface: An academic article that spends its time on some ancient conspiracy or story line.
explanation.definitionFit: A monograph is a detailed scholarly treatise on a single subject, a kind of written paper.

clue.text: Planet has a harmful influence

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the fourth planet from the sun
second meaning: to mar something is to spoil it

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests astrology, a planet exerting a bad influence; the two halves are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Mars names the red planet, and the verb mar means to spoil, so 'mars' means damages.

clue.text: Not even one of two in three is out of order

indicators.note: out of order means not in the right sequence, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone complains that one of three things being out of order spoils a pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Neither means not the one and not the other of two options.

clue.text: Go round something sticky

parts.note: O is round in shape, so stands for round

explanation.surface: An instruction to walk around a sticky patch.
explanation.definitionFit: Goo is a thick, viscous substance, a sticky mess.

clue.text: Trouble following fool's attack

indicators.note: following puts the word for trouble after the word for fool

parts.note: an ass is a fool; the 's stands for 'is' and joins
to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: A fool's attack comes after some trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To assail is to attack violently, physically or with words.

clue.text: Put up painting, say, for cleaning?

parts.note: to house people is to put them up
a painting is an example of a work of art

explanation.surface: Hanging a picture on the wall as part of a domestic chore.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks cleaning as one example of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Housework covers domestic chores, of which cleaning is a typical example.

clue.text: Bow made of stripped larch

indicators.note: stripped means the tree name has its outer covering peeled away, so its first and last letters go

explanation.surface: An archer's bow carved from larch wood with the bark removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bow in the sense of a curved shape is an arc, as in the bend of a rainbow.

clue.text: Area with rather attractive grave

parts.note: cute means pleasingly pretty, rather attractive

explanation.surface: A churchyard plot with a fairly pretty grave.
explanation.walkthrough: Grave looks like a burial place, but it is the adjective meaning serious.
explanation.definitionFit: An acute or grave situation is severe and critical, so the adjectives are synonyms.

clue.text: Beats initially typifying any naval sailor's drum given a turn?

parts.note: to cap something is to outdo or beat it

indicators.note: initially means the opening letter of each of the next three words is taken

explanation.surface: Drumbeats typical of naval music played by a sailor on a turning drum.
explanation.definitionFit: A capstan is a revolving cylinder on a ship, turned to wind in cables or anchor chain.

clue.text: Disastrous game in Oxford University Society

parts.note: RU is rugby union, the usual crossword game
OUS is the abbreviation for Oxford University Society

explanation.surface: A calamitous match played by members of an Oxford student club.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ruinous causes ruin, so it is catastrophic or disastrous.

clue.text: Illegally seize something from Manchu, surprisingly

indicators.note: something from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A historical picture of a Manchu ruler unexpectedly grabbing power or property.
explanation.definitionFit: To usurp is to take a throne or power wrongfully, without legal right.

clue.text: Tests machine for adjustment correction

indicators.note: something sent for adjustment gets its parts rearranged, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: An engineer runs checks on a machine before tweaking it.
explanation.definitionFit: Chastisement is punishment or rebuke given to put someone right, an old sense of correction.

clue.text: Brilliant set of directors, right?

parts.note: star as an adjective means outstanding, brilliant
a company's directors make up its board

explanation.surface: Someone checking that an excellent board of directors has been chosen.
explanation.definitionFit: Starboard is the right-hand side of a ship facing forward.

clue.text: Grain husks for cornflake recipe appeal

indicators.note: husks are the outer shells of grain, so only the outside letters of each following word are kept

explanation.surface: Breakfast-food talk: husks add appeal to a cornflake recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: A cereal is a grass grown for its edible grain, such as wheat, oats or maize.

clue.text: Savoy perhaps putting luggage item in taxi with energy

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
a bag is an item of luggage
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A guest arriving at the Savoy hotel loads a suitcase into a cab.
explanation.walkthrough: The bag is loaded into the taxi only loosely: it simply follows CAB, then E is added. The Savoy looks like the London hotel, but a savoy is also a crinkly-leaved vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Savoy is a variety of crinkle-leaved cabbage, an example of the vegetable.

clue.text: Like some goose egg good and ancient

parts.note: olden means of times long past, ancient

explanation.surface: Describing a fine, very old egg from a goose.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition points to the fable of the goose that laid the golden eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: In the fable the magic goose lays eggs made of gold, so its egg is described with this adjective.

clue.text: Hollow in end of canine may show this

definitions.text: Hollow in end of canine may show this

parts.note: a dent is a hollow or depression

indicators.note: end of means only the final letter of the following word is used

explanation.surface: A dentist notes that a cavity at the tip of a canine tooth exposes the inner layer.
explanation.definitionFit: Dentine is the hard tissue beneath tooth enamel, exposed when a tooth is chipped or worn.

clue.text: Perfectionist exercises Italian poet endlessly

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercises

indicators.note: endlessly means the final letter of the name is cut off

parts.note: Dante is the great Italian poet

explanation.surface: A fussy Italian poet works out without stopping.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedant fusses over minor details and rules, an obsessive perfectionist.

clue.text: Support slowing down in speech that's exhausting

parts.note: to back someone is to support them

indicators.note: in speech means the word is taken as heard spoken, not as written

parts.note: braking is slowing a vehicle down

explanation.surface: Physical therapy talk: support for slowing down that is said to be tiring.
explanation.definitionFit: Backbreaking work is so physically demanding that it is utterly tiring.

clue.text: Block hydrogen being put into fuel

indicators.note: being put into places the element's symbol inside the fuel

parts.note: coke is a fuel made from coal
H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen

explanation.surface: A fuel line gets blocked when hydrogen is pumped into it.
explanation.definitionFit: To choke a pipe or channel is to clog or obstruct it.

clue.text: Group around a throne, perhaps

indicators.note: around means the word for group goes about the letter A

parts.note: a set is a group of things

explanation.surface: Courtiers gathered around a throne.
explanation.definitionFit: A throne is a ceremonial chair, so it is one example of a seat.

clue.text: Incense, perhaps of note, mostly of the Catholic Church

parts.note: A is a musical note

indicators.note: mostly means most but not all of the word is used, so its last letter goes

parts.note: Roman, as in Roman Catholic, describes the church of Rome

explanation.surface: Church incense described as notable for its connection with Catholic worship.
explanation.definitionFit: Burning incense gives off a fragrant smell; that scent is one example of a pleasant odour.

clue.text: Structure I have to keep records

parts.note: an arch is a curved building structure
I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: Someone explains they own a building for storing documents.
explanation.definitionFit: To archive is to store documents or data so they are preserved for future reference.

clue.text: Greek character's cold greeting

parts.note: C stands for cold, as on taps
hi is an informal greeting

explanation.surface: A Greek person gives a frosty hello.
explanation.definitionFit: Chi is the twenty-second letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Sheep is how I refer to my solvers, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means the word is taken as it is heard, not spelt

parts.words: how I refer to my solvers
parts.note: the setter addresses the solvers as 'you'

explanation.surface: The setter muses on the way they address the people doing the puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym by example: the female of the sheep species is called by this name, as a mare is a female horse.

clue.text: Loss of red mitten, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone awry, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone sadly mislays a red woollen mitten.
explanation.definitionFit: Detriment means harm or damage, and to someone's detriment means to their cost or loss.
